about: The Drift's render machines (the user, 2026-10-29): the only studio boxes the dashboard shows and the farm sends work to. name = studio-manager's fleet name (../studio-manager/fleet.config.json), tailnet = its MagicDNS label, tailnetIp its Tailscale address (the dashboard asks the box's studio-manager agent at http://<tailnet>:4310). speed = relative frame rate, 1.0 = an RTX 4090 desktop; the starting guess until out/drift/farm/speeds.json has measured rates. maxLanes = render lanes (Chrome pages) at once. battery: a laptop, the queue refuses to render on battery. Static facts only: whether a box takes jobs (accepting, draining, paused, removed) is set at run time from the dashboard (out/drift/farm/nodes-state.json, scripts/drift-farm.mjs). morpheus and msi are not render machines.
